methods.label: Use the same proportionality constant
methods.explanation:
Direct proportionality means that the same constant relates each two-year population increase to the intervening population. Let \(x\) be the population in \(1996\), and let \(k\) be this constant. Applying the rule to the two consecutive three-year periods gives
\[
x-39=60k,
\qquad 123-60=kx.
\]
The first equation gives \(k=(x-39)/60\). Substituting this into the second eliminates the unknown constant:
\[
63=\frac{x(x-39)}{60}.
\]
Thus
\[
\begin{aligned}
x^2-39x-3780&=0,\\
(x-84)(x+45)&=0.
\end{aligned}
\]
The possible roots are \(84\) and \(-45\). A population cannot be negative, so only \(x=84\) is admissible.

It also satisfies the original conditions: \(39<60<84<123\), and
\[
\frac{84-39}{60}=\frac{123-60}{84}=\frac34.
\]
Therefore the population in \(1996\) was \(\boxed{84}\), choice \(\mathrm B\).
